research_notes: Identify all paid employment before QFF in 2014, including any work during or between the architecture and MBA studies.
Obtain QFF appointment/cessation, hours and leave and resolve the exact 2014–15 handover to the Property Council.
Obtain Property Council role-change dates, hours, leave and final cessation; resolve overlap with 2020 candidacy and 2021 preselection/campaigning.
Confirm paid status and hours for party positions; party-organisation activity remains excluded.

Follow-up2026-10-02: reread appointment and preselection releases, dated2019reproduction, indexed2021CEOstatement, member biography and first speech. Separate intended contractual arrangements from verified staff periods; publication dates are not actual employment boundaries.

Searches for QFF historical staffing/annual reports, personal professional profiles, pre2014architecture work and automotive advocacy returned no additional attributable employer history. Unrelated Henry Pike profiles excluded. Further leads: actual2019/2021contracts and return-to-staff dates; automotive client/employer;QFF2014–15transition; university completion and paid student work.

Recovered source error: MirageNews full2021release open returned Internal Error, URL not accessible via this tool; publicly indexed employer release retained with limitation. No job-wide blocking error.

Follow-up 2026-10-03: targeted searches for an attributable automotive-industry employer/client, QFF staff history, Property Council consultancy implementation, pre-2014 architecture work and university dates returned the existing biographies/releases or unrelated namesakes. No new career fact was added. Do not turn the 2019 or 2021 announced contracting arrangements into worked intervals without implementation evidence.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Targeted automotive-employer searches, including FCAI/VACC/MTA, QFF2014staff records, university graduation and Property Council2020consultancy implementation found only the existing maiden speech and announced arrangements. Historical Ian Henry Pike and unrelated US students rejected. No client entity, actual contract implementation, new boundary, hours or leave recovered; no career field changed. Future follow-up needs attributable automotive records, original2019/2021contracts and staff return dates, rather than repeated announcement searches.

Follow-up2026-10-05: targeted automotive associations(FCAI/MTA/AAA),2013communications history and QFF2014original-staff material did not identify an automotive employer/client or dated QFF appointment. Maiden speech still gives industries only; citing FCAI sales figures in a parliamentary speech is not prior employment evidence. UK car-parts customer reviews and US inmate/newspaper namesakes rejected. No evidence that2019/2021announced Property Council consulting contracts were implemented, nor effective staff-resignation/return boundaries or hours. No career-field enrichment or totals. Retain explicit future contract/archival-staff leads and avoid treating an industry-advocacy claim or announcement as a fully worked interval.

Second targeted follow-up 2026-10-05: primary electricity-distributor customer-service-standard report adds a2020 Property Council workshop-representation observation after the2019 intended staff resignation. It does not establish consultancy contract implementation, staff return, hours or payroll boundaries; linked to unresolved2019 arrangement as contextual evidence only. Full PDF text accessible but screenshot retrieval returned404 Not Found; no extra claim relies on unseen layout. Public professional-profile search yielded UK technology/fitness, US scouting and Australian Allens lawyer namesakes, not an attributable MP CV. Automotive employer and pre2014 paid work remain unidentified.
